prompts.text:
An "I'm Bama Bound" trend video made from [Image 1]: the person in [Image 1] holds a red banner over their head in a sunny green field, then screams, jumps and cheers as if they just got into college on a full ride. One continuous shot with no cuts, filmed like a real phone video by a friend a few steps away at chest height. Vertical 9:16, photorealistic and sharp, bright midday sun.

The person is the one in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), and the clothes from [Image 1]. Keep their real skin tone from [Image 1], never darker or lighter, and their real body shape and size from [Image 1]: never slimmer, curvier, taller or more muscular, never reshaped. The same face from the first frame to the last, so their friends recognize them at once, also in the jump and the scream. Never morph. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the person is that animal standing upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

The banner: a long, flat, bright red rectangular banner, about as wide as the raised arms, with the words I'M BAMA BOUND in big, bold white capital letters on two lines (I'M on the first line, BAMA BOUND on the second). The banner shows only these words: no logo of any kind (no script letter, no emblem, no animal), no school name, no small print and no other words.

The place: a wide, sunny field of short green grass on a bright summer day, a line of tall green trees behind, and a clear deep-blue sky with a few thin white clouds. Framed from the knees up, the face large and sharp.

0-2 s: the person stands in the middle of the field, both arms straight up, holding the banner high above the head with both hands, and smiles proudly into the camera.
2-4 s: they look up at the banner, the mouth falls open in disbelief, then they scream with joy into the camera.
4-6.5 s: they jump up and down twice with the banner still high over the head, laughing and cheering, the grass flicking under their feet.
6.5-8 s: they land, pump the banner up and down over the head and grin into the camera.

Audio: their happy scream, laughter and cheers, a light breeze and an upbeat original beat. No words, no lyrics, no other voices.

Exactly one person. Anatomy rules: one head, two arms, two hands with five fingers each. The banner stays flat, in one piece, with the same words the whole time. No school logo, no script letter, no mascot, no school name, no captions, no subtitles, no watermark and no other text anywhere.
